      public <E extends Throwable> void step(String name, Session.StepBody<E> body) throws E
      Runs the body in a span named after the step, with screenshots as the options say: before and after, after, or none. If the body fails, a screenshot of the failure is taken, and the failure is recorded on the span and rethrown.
